services.title: Preventive Lifestyle Medicine

reviews.reviewText: Dr. Maanvita is exceptionally patient and thorough. She explained my mother's blood tests in simple Hindi and adjusted her medications smoothly without piling on unnecessary drugs.
Very clean clinic and minimal waiting time. When I had high viral fever, doctor monitored my platelet counts daily on WhatsApp. Highly empathetic and knowledgeable!
Quick WhatsApp reply for consultation hours and excellent bedside manner. My blood pressure is now well controlled within 3 weeks with simple lifestyle tweaks.
Diagnosed my chronic thyroid fatigue after multiple other clinics dismissed it as stress. Her dosage guidance was spot-on and my energy levels have bounced back.
Our entire family consults Dr. Maanvita for any fever or seasonal illness. She listens carefully for 15+ minutes and never rushes the patient out of the room.
Very sensible medical approach. She reviewed my annual lipid profile and gave practical diet guidance instead of prescribing statins straight away. Truly trustworthy.

faqs.question: Do I need a prior appointment before visiting?
faqs.answer: Walk-ins are welcomed during all clinic hours. However, messaging on WhatsApp or calling ahead helps assign an estimated consultation window, minimizing your waiting room time.

faqs.question: What is the consultation fee and follow-up policy?
faqs.answer: The standard consultation fee is ₹600. All patients are eligible for one complimentary follow-up visit within 7 days of the initial consultation for review of lab reports or treatment progress.

faqs.question: Is home blood sample collection available?
faqs.answer: Yes, our clinic partners with certified NABL diagnostic laboratory partners. You can schedule a phlebotomist visit for home sample collection by informing clinic reception.

faqs.question: What payment modes are accepted at the clinic?
faqs.answer: We accept all digital payment options including UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM), debit/credit cards, and cash.

faqs.question: How do I receive my prescription and reports?
faqs.answer: You receive both a printed hard copy and an official verified digital prescription delivered directly to your WhatsApp number immediately following the consultation.

faqs.question: Can I consult Dr. Maanvita over WhatsApp for follow-ups?
faqs.answer: Yes! Existing patients can send their lab test reports and quick dosage follow-up queries to the clinic WhatsApp number during clinic working hours.

faqs.question: Are medical fitness and sick leave certificates provided?
faqs.answer: Yes, official verified medical fitness certificates and sick leave verification are issued following physical clinical assessment, stamped with DMC registration credentials.

faqs.question: What emergency facilities are available?
faqs.answer: The clinic provides primary acute emergency stabilization (oxygen, nebulization, primary wound dressing, glucose revival). Severe trauma or cardiac emergencies are stabilized and referred to partner tertiary hospitals.
